Office Visit - Follow-up
Patient: Hana Fairbanks | DOB: 10/15/1994 | MRN: SYN-8649448
Date of service: 04/07/2025 | Dr. Felix Northcott, MD

History of present illness:
30-year-old woman seen for follow-up of low back pain. Low back pain radiating to the right leg for 12 weeks.

Treatment to date:
Completed 9 weeks of physical therapy and daily naproxen without adequate relief.

History:
Past medical history: type 2 diabetes, hypertension.
Medications: metformin 500 mg twice daily; lisinopril 10 mg daily.

Review of systems:
Red flag screen negative: denies bowel or bladder dysfunction, saddle anesthesia, fever, unexplained weight loss, or history of cancer.

Physical exam:
Back: tenderness over the lower lumbar paraspinal muscles; straight-leg raise positive on the right at 30 degrees.
Neuro: strength 4/5 in right plantar flexion, right Achilles reflex 1+, decreased light touch over the lateral right foot.

Assessment and plan:
Assessment: right S1 lumbar radiculopathy.
Plan: MRI lumbar spine without contrast to evaluate for disc herniation; home exercise program; follow up after imaging.
